455:t_2:67.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Then is $$ミコノ$$ confronting $$ミカゲ$$ right now?」

455:t_2:68.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That's what the old man $$不動$$ said.」

455:t_2:69.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Why were you sent into this space, $$カグラ$$...?」

455:t_2:70.en:
$$カグラ$$
「He told me to come get you.」

455:t_2:72.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That old bastard... He's always pushing people around however he likes... Does he think I'm his pet or something?」

455:t_2:73.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Ah... I kind of know what you mean.」

455:t_2:74.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Is this any time to grin!? She's up against $$ミカゲ$$!」

455:t_2:75.en:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ミコノ$$'s bound to be in trouble by now!」

455:t_2:78.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...I can hear... $$ミコノ$$'s voice...」

455:t_2:79.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But something's strange... It's almost like there are two $$ミコノ$$s...」

455:t_2:80.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That must be $$シルヴィア$$.」

455:t_2:81.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$シルヴィア$$... $$ミコノ$$'s past life...!」

455:t_2:82.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Yeah, that's right. Old man $$不動$$ said he'd summon her to settle everything.」

455:t_2:83.en:
$$カグラ$$
「If she's there with $$ミコノ$$, he must be there too.」

455:t_2:85.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Yeah. Our past life... $$アポロ$$.」

455:t_2:87.en:
$$カグラ$$
「But what can we do...? $$神話型アクエリオン$$ is in $$ミカゲ$$'s hands...」

455:t_2:88.en:
$$カグラ$$
「As long as he has it, his hatred keeps growing, and we don't stand a chance...」

455:t_2:90.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Do it? What are you talking about?」

455:t_2:91.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$神話型アクエリオン$$ unleashes its power when three powers become one...」

455:t_2:92.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It was built by $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the $$天翅$$ of Slaughter... And $$アポロ$$, our past life, was once his pet winged dog $$ポロン$$...」

455:t_2:93.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So I'm sure $$アクエリオン$$ will answer our cry.」

455:t_2:94.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You, me, and $$アポロ$$... That's three powers, huh.」

455:t_2:95.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right! Now we'll take the light that fell into darkness... the sun, back into our hands!」

455:t_2:97.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Yeah, we've got no choice! The three of us will take back the sun!!」

455:t_2:102.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'll burn you to ashes! You hateful woman who stole my beloved $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ from me!」

455:t_2:104.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm sorry... I've been turning away all this time...」

455:t_2:105.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「From the sin of taking the one you loved away from you... And from your sorrow...!」

455:t_2:107.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「We will accept your sorrow!」

455:t_2:108.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「And I'll connect you...! I'll connect the souls torn apart by love and sorrow!」

455:t_2:112.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Are you saying you accept it!? That the one our beloved $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ loved would be united with a little winged dog in the next life!?」

455:t_2:113.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(Those who lose in love can only leave... That applies to $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ and me alike.)

455:t_2:114.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(But we need not wallow in sorrow or be consumed by hatred. Let us love the one our beloved loves as well.)

455:t_2:115.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's filthy! The love of the Wingless!」

455:t_2:117.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Humans and $$天翅$$s are no different! We all have hearts that can love!」

455:t_2:118.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(Yes... And that cry of love transcends even dimensions.)

455:t_2:120.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A dog's howl...!? No, that's not it!」

455:t_2:122.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That is a cry of the soul like $$アポロ$$'s... But it isn't $$アポロ$$'s...!」

455:t_2:123.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「So that's the person you love, $$ミコノ$$.」

455:t_2:126.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I can hear him even more clearly now!」

455:t_2:127.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$アポロ$$! This is no time for you to be sleeping either!」

455:t_2:129.en:
$$シリウス$$
(Heh... So the sun will rise again from deep within the earth...)

455:t_2:132.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(This is the power of those who love each other.)

455:t_3:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

455:t_3:7.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「What is with this guy...!?」

455:t_3:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...Yeah, you smell a little different from $$シルヴィア$$. How do I put it... You're kind of... strangely wimpy...」

455:t_3:10.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You're different here too. You don't have $$ミコノ$$'s soft, sweet scent. Yours is more... kind of... aggressive...」

455:t_3:12.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You two... I think sniffing girls all over without asking their permission is a little wrong.」

455:t_3:13.en:
$$カグラ$$
「What are you talking about? Of course we need to check out the newcomers.」

455:t_3:14.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You're a newcomer among us too, you know...」
